entities.summary: Alexander Rafailovich Boikov is a Russian former professional ice hockey forward who played in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was a captain for HC Sibir Novosibirsk for two seasons. He ended his 21-year professional career, following the 2011-12 season with Severstal Cherepovets.
